About (Plain Text):
INTRODUCTION 
Women Aid Empowerment Network Initiatives a dedicated organization committed to uplifting the lives of the less privileged, and empowering Women and The Girl Child through skill acquisitions, awareness and campaign on health education, menstrual hygiene management, free health services and other essential life skills. 
Aims and Objectives: 
	Unite to end violence against women and the Girl Child.
	Advocacy against sexual abuse and gender base violence.
	Offering financial assistance and vocational training to improve self-sufficiency. 
Programs: 
	Organizing free health and medical check-ups. 
	Facilitating educational programs on health management. 
	Programme to help take Women and the Girl Child off the streets through empowerment. 
Our mission is to create a positive and sustainable impact on the communities we serve. However, to achieve these objectives, we rely on the generosity and support of individuals and organizations.
